name: ABB Ltd.
summary: ABB Ltd, established in 1883 and headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, operates as a global technology pioneer, delivering electrification, automation, robotics, and motion products and solutions. The company caters to a diverse international clientele across utilities, industrial, transportation, and infrastructure sectors. Its Electrification segment provides a comprehensive array of offerings, including electric vehicle charging infrastructure, renewable power solutions, modular substation packages, distribution automation products, various types of switchgear and panel boards, UPS systems, circuit breakers, measuring and sensing devices, control products, wiring accessories, and advanced intelligent home and building solutions. The Robotics & Discrete Automation segment specializes in industrial robots, specialized software, autonomous mobile robotics, and complete robotic solutions, alongside field services, spare parts, and digital support. This segment also incorporates programmable logic controllers, industrial PCs, servo motion control, advanced transport systems, and machine vision into its technological solutions. The Motion segment is dedicated to designing, manufacturing, and marketing drives, motors, generators, and traction converters, all of which are instrumental in fostering a low-carbon future for industries, urban environments, infrastructure projects, and transportation systems. Finally, ABB's Process Automation segment develops and supplies critical control technologies, sophisticated process control software, manufacturing execution systems, and a broad spectrum of sensing, measurement, and analytical instrumentation. This segment also provides marine propulsion systems and turbochargers, augmented by essential services such as remote monitoring, preventive maintenance, asset performance management, emission monitoring, and cybersecurity. The firm's expansive customer base encompasses a multitude of industries, including aluminum, automotive, battery manufacturing, buildings and infrastructure, cement, chemical, data centers, food and beverage, life sciences, marine, mining, oil and gas, ports, power generation, printing, pulp and paper, railway, smart cities, water management, and wind power.

name: Coca-Cola HBC AG
summary: Coca-Cola HBC AG is a worldwide bottler and seller of an extensive array of ready-to-drink beverages. Its comprehensive portfolio features carbonated soft drinks, hydrating options, fruit juices, ready-to-drink teas, energy boosters, coffee, bottled water, and plant-based drinks, plus premium spirits, flavored alcoholic beverages, and snacks. It markets and sells its products under well-known brand names like Coca-Cola, Fanta, Sprite, and Schweppes, among others. Established in 1969, the company's corporate headquarters are located in Steinhausen, Switzerland.

name: Cellcom Israel Ltd.
summary: Cellcom Israel Ltd. is a leading provider of mobile telecommunications services throughout Israel. The company offers a wide array of services, encompassing internet access and core infrastructure, internet television, international and fixed-line voice telephony, and data transmission services tailored for both corporate clients and fellow telecommunications operators. Founded in 1994, Cellcom Israel Ltd. is headquartered in Netanya, Israel, and functions as a subsidiary of Discount Investment Corporation Ltd.

name: Capital Trade Links Limited
summary: Capital Trade Links Limited is involved in trading and investment activities. They deal in various commodities and securities. The company is based in India.

name: Core Lithium Ltd
summary: Core Lithium Ltd engages in the exploration of lithium and base metals deposits in Australia. The company primarily explores for copper, gold, iron, silver, uranium, lead, and zinc deposits. It develops the Finniss Lithium project located to the south of Darwin port in the Northern Territory in Australia. The company was formerly known as Core Exploration Limited and changed its name to Core Lithium Ltd in November 2018. The company was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Adelaide, Australia.

name: Danakali Limited
summary: Danakali Limited, along with its associated entities, is active in the mineral exploration sector, primarily within Eritrea, East Africa. The company's central focus is the advancement of the Colluli potash project, situated in Eritrea's Danakil Depression region. Originally incorporated in 2001, the firm was formerly known as South Boulder Mines Ltd. before officially adopting the Danakali Limited name in June 2015. Its corporate headquarters are located in Perth, Australia.

name: Enterprise Metals Limited
summary: Enterprise Metals Limited engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties in Western Australia. The company explores for copper, gold, nickel, zinc, iron ore, lithium, and base metals. Its primary projects include Murchison, Doolgunna, and Fraser Range projects located in Western Australia. The company was formerly known as Revere Mining Limited and changed its name to Enterprise Metals Limited in December 2008. Enterprise Metals Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is based in West Perth, Australia.

name: ETAO International
summary: ETAO International Co., Ltd. is a digital healthcare company, which engages in the provision of telemedicine, hospital care, primary care, pharmacy, and health insurance covering life stages of patients. The company was founded by Wen Sheng Liu on June 30, 2022 and is headquartered in New York, NY.

name: FOLLI FOLLIE Commercial Manufacturing And Technical S.A.
summary: FOLLI FOLLIE Commercial Manufacturing And Technical Société Anonyme is a company that focuses on the creation, production, and sale of jewelry, timepieces, and various accessories. Their fashion accessory collection includes items like handbags, wallets, leather goods, pashminas, and sunglasses. The company engages in both direct retail sales and wholesale distribution of its offerings. It also supplies its products wholesale to a selection of international retail partners. In Greece, FOLLI FOLLIE operates its own department stores located in Athens and Thessaloniki, in addition to managing several discount department stores. Beyond its primary categories, the company is also involved in the retail and wholesale trade of branded clothing, footwear, fragrances, cosmetics, and other related merchandise. Established in 1982, FOLLI FOLLIE is headquartered in Athens, Greece, and maintains a network of retail stores across both Greece and Cyprus.

name: Hachijuni Bank Ltd/The
summary: Hachijuni Bank, Ltd. operates as a comprehensive financial institution, delivering a wide array of banking products and services to individual consumers, sole proprietors, and corporate clients. Its extensive product portfolio includes a diverse range of deposit accounts, such as savings, fixed-term, structured, foreign currency, property, public, payment, and relay deposits. The bank also provides various lending solutions, encompassing personal loans for housing, vehicles, education, medical expenses, and home remodeling, alongside business loans, founding support, overdraft facilities, and specific card and 'Hachini free' loan options. Further offerings extend to investment vehicles like public and private placement bonds, and a full suite of insurance products covering life, medical, education, and property (fire). Hachijuni Bank also issues credit and debit cards and provides wealth management services, including pension plans, investment trusts, inheritance solutions, and pension consultation. For customer convenience and business support, it offers internet and mobile banking, foreign currency reserve services, payment collection, expense settlement, management and business support, and information on civil trusts. Additionally, the bank engages in the brokerage of financial products. As of March 31, 2022, Hachijuni Bank maintained a substantial operational footprint, with 142 branches, 9 branch offices, and 221 ATMs across Japan. Its international presence included a branch in Hong Kong and three representative offices located in Shanghai, Bangkok, and Singapore. Established in 1877, the bank is headquartered in Nagano, Japan.

name: Hensoldt
summary: Hensoldt AG operates globally as a key provider of sophisticated electronic sensor technology for defense and security sectors. Its diverse product lineup features an array of radar systems for aerial, ground, naval, and space surveillance, alongside applications for commercial shipping. The company also specializes in Identification Friend or Foe (IFF) systems and secure data communication links. Within its optronics division, Hensoldt offers advanced airborne, vehicle, and maritime surveillance equipment, space optics, and various optical sensor devices, including sights, scopes, and night-vision attachments. For electronic warfare, it supplies products for electronic support/SIGINT, receivers, direction finders, electronic attackers/jammers, self-protection EW software suites, and ground support stations. Furthermore, its avionics portfolio encompasses airborne computing, flight and mission data management, connectivity, pilot assistance, video management, and integrated solutions for manned and unmanned platforms, complete with planning support, data analysis, and cloud services. Hensoldt also delivers counter-UAV solutions and command-and-control software. Complementing its product offerings, the company provides extensive support, simulation, and training services, along with essential infrastructure components like antennas, cabling, shelters, and testing equipment. The company's headquarters are located in Taufkirchen, Germany.

name: Happy Belly Food
summary: Happy Belly Food Group Inc. is a company listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange under the ticker HBFG. It operates in the Food Products industry within the Consumer Staples sector. The company is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Colonial SFL Socimi SA
summary: Colonial SFL, Socimi S. A. is the leading platform in Europe's prime commercial real estate market, with a presence in the in the main business districts of Barcelona, Madrid, and Paris. It boasts a unique portfolio of totaling more than 1 million euros, with a market value exceeding 12 billion euros. The Group follows a dedicated, long-term strategy focused on value creation through a high-quality client portfolio and asset appreciation. Looking ahead, Colonial SFL will continue to lead the urban transformation of city centers in the cities in the European market, recognized for its experience and professionalism, financial strength and profitability, to time that provides excellent sustainable real estate solutions adapted to the needs of its clients.

name: Komo Plant Based Foods
summary: Komo Plant Based Comfort Foods Inc., based in Vancouver, Canada, specializes in creating, producing, and distributing frozen, plant-derived meal options, including lasagna, shepherd's pie, and chick'n pot pie. Established in 2018, the company adopted its current name in March 2021.

name: Life Electric Vehicles
summary: Life Electric Vehicles Holdings Inc. is primarily involved in the development, production, and distribution of electric vehicles, placing particular emphasis on electric bicycles. This entity, which previously operated as Second Street Capital, Inc., is headquartered in Deerfield Beach, Florida.

name: Menora
summary: Menora Mivtachim Holdings Ltd operates in insurance and finance sectors in Israel. The company offers life and health, and general insurance products, as well as automobile insurance products, such as compulsory automobile or property car insurance products; and pension and provident funds. It also engages in the mutual funds and portfolio management, securities underwriting, and real estate investment activities. The company was formerly known as General Liability Office Ltd. and changed its name to Menora Mivtachim Holdings Ltd in 2006. Menora Mivtachim Holdings Ltd was founded in 1935 and is based in Tel Aviv, Israel.

name: Mushrooms
summary: Mushrooms, Inc. is a biotechnology company that develops products from mushrooms and mycelium. The company focuses on mycelium's industrial applications for carbon-neutral products, health supplements, and technologies for healthcare and textiles, such as bacterial detection and nutrient delivery. The company was formerly known as Marijuana Strategic Ventures Inc. and changed its name to Mushrooms Inc. in October 2022. [20, 22, 28, 33]

name: The Planting Hope Company
summary: The Planting Hope Company Inc. specializes in the production of health-conscious food items and snacks, distributing them across the United States and Canada. Its activities involve the development, introduction, and scaling of nourishing, pre-packaged food and beverage products for consumers. The company's product line features sesamemilk under the brand "Hope & Sesame," vegetable-based chips marketed as "Mozaics," and an assortment of wholesome plant-derived snacks identified as "Veggicopia." These offerings are made available through wholesale distribution networks, direct sales to businesses, direct-to-consumer channels, and traditional retail outlets. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, the entity operated as Campio Capital Corp. until May 2021, when it officially became The Planting Hope Company, Inc.

name: OUTsurance Group Ltd
summary: OUTsurance Group Limited is a company listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange under the ticker OUT. It operates in the Insurance industry within the Financials sector. The company is headquartered in Centurion, South Africa.

name: SDI Group
summary: SDI Group plc, through its subsidiaries, designs and manufactures scientific and technology products based on digital imaging in the United Kingdom, rest of Europe, the United States, Asia, and internationally. The company offers sensitive cameras for life science and industrial applications under the Atik Camera brand name; cameras for art conservation Opus Instruments brand name; and cameras that have applications in astronomy, life sciences, and flat panel inspection under the Quantum Scientific Imaging brand name. It also designs and manufactures precision re-circulating chillers, coolers, and heat exchangers to control the thermal environment within life science and analytical systems; and supplies chemical dosing and control systems to the manufacturers of beverage cans. In addition, the company offers off-the-shelf and custom-made electrochemical sensors for water based applications under the Sentek name; systems and software for automated gel-based DNA and protein fluorescence/chemiluminescence imaging under the G:BOX and NuGenius brands; automated and manual systems for microbiological testing in food, water, pharmaceutical, and clinical applications; and ProReveal, a fluorescence-based patented protein detection test to check for residual protein on surgical instruments after they have been through a washer disinfector. Further, it engages in the design, manufacture, and calibration of pressure, vacuum, and gas flow measurement instruments; and flowmeters, flow alarms, flow indicators, flow switches, calibration cylinders, and sight glasses for the measurement of liquids and gases; and precision micropattern products, as well as water purification products and vacuum ovens under the Cyclon Water Still and Gallenkamp vacuum ovens brands. The company was formerly known as Scientific Digital Imaging plc and changed its name to SDI Group plc in November 2019. SDI Group plc was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Cambridge, the United Kingdom.

name: Sparc Al Inc
summary: Sparc AI Inc. is a software and engineering firm specializing in the creation, patenting, and commercialization of its proprietary SPARC (Spatial, Predictive, Approximation, and Radial Convolution) technology. This innovative SPARC solution empowers various devices—such as sensors, cameras, and smartphones, regardless of whether they are fixed, mobile, airborne, portable, or handheld—to function as precise target coordinate acquisition systems. The company's portfolio also includes a Target Acquisition System, a software platform engineered to determine the exact location of any distant object, alongside an autonomous flight module currently under development. Established in 2018, Sparc AI Inc. was formerly known as EYEFI Group Technologies Inc. before rebranding in August 2023, and its operations are based in Melbourne, Australia.

name: Vusion
summary: Vusion S.A. engages in the provision of digitalization solutions for commerce in Europe, Asia, and North America. Its products include VusionLive, which connects in-store operations with data-augmented intelligence; VusionCloud, an IoT platform that optimizes physical store operations from end to end; SESimagotag, an electronic shelf labels that digitalize shelves; Captana that offers Al and computer vision to maximize on-shelf availability and store performance; Engage, an in-store retail media, which runs digital campaigns; Memory Retail Intelligence; and PDI digital Industrial IoT. The company was formerly known as VusionGroup S.A. and changed its name to Vusion S.A. in January 2026. The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Nanterre, France.

name: Samsung C&T Corp
summary: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. engages in the consumer electronics, information technology and mobile communications, and device solutions businesses worldwide. It offers digital TVs, monitors, air conditioners, refrigerators, mobile phones, communication systems, and computers; semiconductor products, such as memory, foundry, and system LSI; and display products comprising LCD and OLED panels, as well as connected car systems, audio and visual products, enterprise automation solutions, and connected services. The company is also involved in the technology and venture capital investment businesses; manufacture of semiconductor equipment and components; and provision of repair services for electronic devices. In addition, it provides medical equipment; software development and supply; toll processing of semiconductors and display panels; general logistics agency, financing, marketing, consulting, and AI technology and cloud services; enterprise automation solutions and connected services; and digital advertising platforms. Further, the company offers mobile payment services; and designs and develops software products. It serves retail, hospitality, finance, transportation, education, government, and healthcare industries. Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. was founded in 1938 and is based in Suwon, South Korea.

name: SM Entertainment Co Ltd
summary: SM ENTERTAINMENT JAPAN Co., Ltd. is active in Japan in satellite (CS) broadcasting, artist management, mobile services, fan clubs, merchandise, events and concerts, music and rights, organized in Entertainment and Rights & Media segments. It runs KNTV, a Korean entertainment channel broadcasting dramas, news, K-pop and variety shows, and plans and produces original programs. Formerly Stream Media Corporation, it took its present name in June 2025.

name: Sunworks Inc
summary: Sunworks, Inc., operating with its subsidiaries, specializes in delivering solar photovoltaic and battery energy storage solutions across various sectors within the United States. Its comprehensive services encompass the design, financial arrangement, integration, installation, and ongoing management of these systems. The company caters to a diverse clientele, including commercial enterprises, agricultural operations, industrial facilities, public infrastructure projects, and individual residential customers. Originally established in 2002 as Solar3D, Inc., the company adopted the name Sunworks, Inc. in March 2016 and is headquartered in Provo, Utah. However, on February 5, 2024, Sunworks, Inc. and its associated companies initiated voluntary liquidation proceedings under Chapter 7 of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code, filing with the District of Delaware's court.

name: Thungela Resources Ltd
summary: Thungela Resources Limited, a South African company, primarily focuses on the extraction and production of thermal coal. The firm manages and sources its coal from seven distinct mining operations, all located within South Africa's Mpumalanga province. These collieries include Goedehoop, Greenside, Isibonelo, Khwezela, Zibulo, Mafube, and Rietvlei. Beyond its domestic activities, Thungela also distributes its coal to various international markets across India, Asia, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and North Africa. Established in 1945, the company maintains its corporate headquarters in Johannesburg, South Africa.

name: Tel Aviv Stock Exchange
summary: The Tel-Aviv Stock Exchange Ltd. manages securities stock exchange and related activities in Israel. The company offers a range of securities and derivative instruments, including shares, corporate bonds, government bonds, treasury bills, ETFs, convertible securities, single stock options, options, and futures. It also operates Tel Aviv Continuous Trading, an automated system for continuous and simultaneous trading that allows the members to send purchase and sale orders continuously and in real time. In addition, the company engages in the clearing and settlement of securities and services; issuing of options and futures; and holding of securities for others. The Tel-Aviv Stock Exchange Ltd. was founded in 1935 and is headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel.

name: Westbridge Renewable Energy
summary: Westbridge Renewable Energy Corp. develops and acquires solar photovoltaic projects in Canada and the United States. Its main asset is the 278 MWp Georgetown project in Vulcan County, Alberta. It fully owns the 221 MWp Accalia project in Cameron County, Texas, and holds 75% of the 236 MWp Sunnynook Project in Alberta, which includes a 100 MW battery storage system.
industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

name: Water Ways Technologies
summary: Water Ways Technologies, Inc. is a holding company, which engages in the provision of water irrigation and agriculture solutions to agriculture producers. It operates through the Project Services Business and Products-Component and Equipment Sales business units. The company was founded on April 20, 2007 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: Lightning eMotors
summary: Lightning eMotors, Inc. is a company focused on the development, manufacturing, and distribution of zero-emission commercial transportation vehicles and their corresponding powertrain systems. They provide these sustainable solutions to a wide array of clients throughout the United States, encompassing private commercial fleet operators, major enterprises, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), and government agencies. Their product offerings include a spectrum of clean-energy commercial vehicles, ranging from Class 3 to Class 7, which utilize either electric or advanced fuel cell technologies. This diverse lineup covers various applications, such as cargo and passenger vans, school buses, emergency service ambulances, shuttle buses, utility work trucks, public transit buses, and long-haul motorcoaches. In addition to vehicles, the company also supplies complete charging systems and robust charging infrastructure solutions. Founded in 2008, Lightning eMotors has its primary operational base in Loveland, Colorado.
